import sys
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext, ROUND_DOWN

# COBOL fixed-point: use Decimal with wide precision, truncate toward zero on store
getcontext().prec = 40

# Field definitions from WORKING-STORAGE
# All numeric fields are unsigned integers with implied scale 0
# WS-A: PIC 9(3) -> 3 digits, max 999
# WS-B: PIC 9(3) -> 3 digits, max 999
# WS-GUARDED: PIC 9(3) -> 3 digits, initial 777
# WS-UNGUARDED: PIC 9(3) -> 3 digits, initial 777
# WS-WIDE: PIC 9(7) -> 7 digits, initial 0
# WS-FLAG: PIC X(8) -> 8 chars, initial "OK"

def accept_numeric_3digit(line: str) -> int:
    """
    ACCEPT for PIC 9(3) unsigned.
    Rule 3b: truncate on RIGHT (keep first 3 chars of line).
    Rule 3c: take leading numeric prefix of that, empty -> 0.
    """
    # Strip trailing newline only (already done by caller), take first 3 chars
    truncated = line[:3]
    # Take leading digits
    digits = ''
    for ch in truncated:
        if ch.isdigit():
            digits += ch
        else:
            break
    if not digits:
        return 0
    return int(digits)

def store_pic9_3(value: int) -> int:
    """Store into PIC 9(3): modulo 1000 (discard high-order digits)."""
    return value % 1000

def store_pic9_7(value: int) -> int:
    """Store into PIC 9(7): modulo 10_000_000."""
    return value % 10_000_000

def display_pic9_3(value: int) -> str:
    """DISPLAY PIC 9(3): zero-padded to exactly 3 digits."""
    return f"{value:03d}"

def display_pic9_7(value: int) -> str:
    """DISPLAY PIC 9(7): zero-padded to exactly 7 digits."""
    return f"{value:07d}"

def display_picx_8(value: str) -> str:
    """DISPLAY PIC X(8): left-justified, space-padded to exactly 8 chars."""
    return value.ljust(8)[:8]

def main_para():
    # Initial values
    ws_a = 0
    ws_b = 0
    ws_guarded = 777
    ws_unguarded = 777
    ws_wide = 0
    ws_flag = "OK"

    # ACCEPT WS-A
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if line.endswith('\n'):
        line = line[:-1]  # strip trailing newline only
    ws_a = accept_numeric_3digit(line)

    # ACCEPT WS-B
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if line.endswith('\n'):
        line = line[:-1]
    ws_b = accept_numeric_3digit(line)

    # COMPUTE WS-GUARDED = WS-A * WS-B ON SIZE ERROR MOVE "OVERFLOW" TO WS-FLAG
    product = ws_a * ws_b
    if product > 999:  # SIZE ERROR for PIC 9(3)
        ws_flag = "OVERFLOW"
        # WS-GUARDED remains completely unchanged (keeps 777)
    else:
        ws_guarded = product  # fits in 3 digits

    # MULTIPLY WS-A BY WS-B GIVING WS-UNGUARDED (no ON SIZE ERROR)
    # High-order digits silently discarded
    ws_unguarded = store_pic9_3(ws_a * ws_b)

    # MULTIPLY WS-A BY WS-B GIVING WS-WIDE (7 digits, no overflow expected but handle anyway)
    ws_wide = store_pic9_7(ws_a * ws_b)

    # DISPLAY statements - each writes one line
    # "GUARDED   " WS-GUARDED
    sys.stdout.write("GUARDED   " + display_pic9_3(ws_guarded) + "\n")
    # "UNGUARDED " WS-UNGUARDED
    sys.stdout.write("UNGUARDED " + display_pic9_3(ws_unguarded) + "\n")
    # "WIDE      " WS-WIDE
    sys.stdout.write("WIDE      " + display_pic9_7(ws_wide) + "\n")
    # "FLAG      " WS-FLAG
    sys.stdout.write("FLAG      " + display_picx_8(ws_flag) + "\n")

    # STOP RUN -> exit 0
    sys.exit(0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main_para()
